compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is promoting a "Premium access" subscription for an app, likely related to flight management or travel. The main features highlighted for the premium access include:

1. **Push and SMS notifications about flights**: Users will receive timely updates and alerts about their flights.
2. **Family members subscription**: The subscription can be extended to include family members.
3. **Autocheckin to all your flights**: The app will automatically check in the user for their flights.

The screen invites users to start a 7-day trial period by clicking the "SUBSCRIBE" button. There is also an option to skip this offer by selecting "SKIP" at the top right corner or "LATER" at the bottom.
